# iosxe_wireless_policy_tag (Data Source)

This data source can read the Wireless Policy Tag configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "iosxe_wireless_policy_tag" "example" {
  tag_name = "S2-PT-CORP"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `tag_name` (String) This object uniquely identifies the policy tag

### Optional

- `device` (String) A device name from the provider configuration.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) description for the policy tag
- `id` (String) The path of the retrieved object.
- `wlan_policies` (Attributes List) WLAN profile and policy profile name configuration (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--wlan_policies))

<a id="nestedatt--wlan_policies"></a>
### Nested Schema for `wlan_policies`

Read-Only:

- `policy_profile_name` (String) Name of the policy profile
- `wlan_profile_name` (String) Name of the WLAN profile
